g.text: Nominal 90% product-time proxy intervals | Temperate land, swath interior (>5 km from edge)
Conditional proxy intervals; exact ROI timing and file access remain unvalidated. Mission rows use different y-scales.
Observed initial TLE ages: 0.14–16.20 days. Lines are visual guides between categorical bins.
